data.name: Anmoll
data.gender_notes: Anmoll is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anmoll is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'amr' meaning honey, and 'oll' meaning vessel or container. This name signifies a sweet, melodious, and nurturing soul. The name Anmoll carries the meaning “Sweet, Melodious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anmoll usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet, melodious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes sweetness and harmony in one's spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Anmoll belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sweet, Melodious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anmoll total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
